name: EDU-RAG
description: A benchmark dataset for evaluating large language model performance on middle-school science question answering, augmented with real-world web search results to assess the effectiveness of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in reducing hallucinations.
reputation: A relatively niche but credible benchmark from the RAG-for-science literature, with limited community adoption compared with major QA benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on evaluating RAG techniques to mitigate hallucinations in LLMs using textbook questions enhanced with web content.
